name: copilot-allowlist-gate
description: This worker is triggered by the `BEFORE_DOWNLOAD` event of Artifactory. It only lets downloads through when the artifact matches a glob in an allowlist file kept in a GitHub repository. Blocked artifacts get a GitHub issue assigned to GitHub Copilot's coding agent, which vets the dependency and opens a PR adding it to the allowlist; merging that PR unblocks the download.
